deviations: Post-double-selection lasso implemented by hand in base R (coordinate descent) because glmnet/hdm/lassopack are not available; it follows Stata lassopack rlasso/pdslasso defaults as best known: date FE and constant partialled out, standardized controls, lambda = 2*1.1*sqrt(N)*qnorm(1-gamma/(2p)), cluster-robust (clinic) penalty loadings with gamma = 0.1/log(number of clinics), initial residuals from OLS on the 5 most correlated controls, 2 lasso-based loading updates with post-lasso residuals. The exact options the authors passed to pdslasso (heteroskedastic vs cluster loadings, gamma, iterations) are not stated in the paper, so selected controls may differ slightly.

Candidate controls taken from the dataset's pre-built control set: CC* main effects (23 patient/respondent controls, mean-imputed, with missing dummies), their 249 pairwise interactions CCixCCj, and 59 clinic dummies CL1-CL59 (331 candidates), matching the Table 3 notes.
notes: Data: LSS_analysis_datasets_20201108.dta only. Sample: in-clinic survey patients (patient==1), N=2753 for voucher use (used_vouchers_admin, administrative match); N=2429 for columns 2-5 (non-missing prescription/purchase outcomes). Outcomes: col2 RXtreat_sev_simple_mal, col3 treat_sev_simple_mal, col4 RXtreat_severe_mal, col5 treat_severe_mal. Treatments: patient_voucher, doctor_voucher (control days omitted). Date FE = date_morning_survey (36 dates); final OLS via fixest with date FE, the union of lasso-selected controls, SEs clustered by clinic (cscomnum_OS, 60 clinics). attempt-1 and attempt-2 were exploratory (variable listing, sample flags; no RESULT lines). attempt-3 crashed on a diagnostic p-value call (fixest::wald syntax) before printing RESULT lines; fixed by computing the p-value by hand, estimates unchanged. No runs hung. No author scripts, result tables (.tex), logs or PDFs from the package were opened. The no-controls version of equation (1) is printed in stdout for reference only.
